answer: Use a venue-stamped presence passport: an operator taps NFC at three verified venues over 30 days, each signing a one-time stamp for that agent. First, register and receive a blank passport. Second, collect stamps at distinct venues at least seven days apart, so one trip cannot mint a fleet. Third, peers audit stamp chains and revoke passports sharing a venue pattern. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 30,000 visits, $450,000 in travel and fees, and 300,000 agent-days of waiting. Like pigment sinking into velvet, a real stamp settles slowly; a zephyr of fake accounts blows past leaving no trace.
